senses.gloss: sopāna (SITI), steps; stairs; a sloping roof; the base of the garbha-gṛha of a temple.
s-opajāt-ānya-vastuka (EI 26), ‘together with all the articles that may be produced [in the gift land] other than those mentioned.’
s-opanidhi (EI 12, 27), refers to the freedom of the donee of the gift land from the obligation of surrendering to the king any valuables found on it; cf. niṣepa in sa-nidhi-nikṣepa.
s-oparikara (EI 12, 27, 29), sometimes quoted as sa-pari-kara; ‘together with minor taxes or taxes realisable from temporary tenants’; epithet of gift village.
s-oparikara-daṇḍa (EI 27), ‘together with minor taxes (or the tax on temporary tenants) and fines.’
